raw_segments.text: Darkness came on, but three lights up and down in the pequod's main rigging dimly guided
Till drawing nearer, we saw Ahab dropping one of several more lanterns over the bulwarks.
Vacantly eyeing the heaving whale for a moment, he issued the usual orders for securing it
for the night, and then handing his lantern to a seaman went his way into the cabin and
did not come forward again until morning.
